title: AI 指令的鍵盤焦點更清楚完整
summary: 使用鍵盤瀏覽 AI 指令時，淡藍底色與內嵌焦點框讓目前操作目標清楚可見，避免邊緣被裁切。
highlights: 指令、圖釘與更多操作使用完整的內嵌焦點框，整列淡藍底色協助定位。
保留已執行指令的左側色條，方便區分目前焦點與結果來源。
名稱完整可見時不再顯示重複提示；被截短的名稱仍可透過延遲提示查看。
usage: 開啟 AI 面板後，使用方向鍵瀏覽指令，按 Tab 移至圖釘或更多操作，再按 Enter 執行。

en.title: See complete keyboard focus in AI commands
en.summary: A pale blue row and inset focus ring clearly identify the current AI command or tool without clipped edges.
highlights: Commands, pins, and more options use inset focus rings, with a pale blue row to help locate focus.
The executed command keeps its left accent bar so the result source stays distinct from keyboard focus.
Fully visible names no longer show duplicate tooltips; truncated names remain available in delayed tooltips.
en.usage: Open the AI panel, browse commands with the arrow keys, press Tab to reach pin or more options, and press Enter to activate the focused control.
